title: Temporal Usage Patterns
insights:
Dataset Summary

Total Events: 44,031

Total Users: 499

Event Types: 80

Date Range: December 24, 2025 - January 20, 2026

Categories: Application Events Only

Temporal Analysis Findings

Peak Hour: 9 AM

Off-Peak Hour: 10 PM

Peak Day: Friday

Low Day: Tuesday

Peak-to-Trough Ratio: 42.7

Analysis

PUSH NOTIFICATION TIMING

The marketing team should send push notifications during peak usage hours for maximum open rates. The exact peak hour is:

  • 9 AM on Fridays

This timing aligns with when users are most active, increasing the likelihood of engagement with notifications.

CAPACITY PLANNING

The app needs maximum server capacity during peak hours to handle the influx of users. The predictable traffic spike occurs:

  • 9 AM on Fridays

Given the peak-to-trough ratio of 42.7, this indicates highly concentrated usage, necessitating robust infrastructure to prevent downtime or slow performance.

MARKETING WINDOWS

The best times for running in-app promotions or flash sales are during peak hours. The data supports focusing on:

  • 9 AM on Fridays

This period is when user engagement is highest, making it an optimal window for promotional activities to maximize conversions.

WEEKEND VS WEEKDAY

The day-of-week distribution suggests that usage is more prevalent on weekdays, particularly on Fridays, indicating a commuter-focused user base rather than a leisure travel app. The low usage on Tuesdays further supports this observation, as it is the least active day. This pattern suggests that users are likely using the app primarily for commuting purposes rather than leisure travel.
